evidence.title: Paris 2 Data Centre | Data Centres in Paris | Colt DCS
evidence.excerpt: Colt says construction has begun on Paris 2 in Villebon-sur-Yvette, identifies it as the first of three data centres being developed at the site, and describes its full operation as future.

metadata.retrieval_method: Exact official HTTP response-body and raw response-header capture with a separately recorded request-start timestamp.
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at is the shared completion timestamp for the four-body Colt next-tranche audit batch. The exact request-start, response HTTP Date, and Last-Modified header are preserved separately.
metadata.source_date_guardrail: The embedded WebPage publication and modification timestamps are page metadata. The later HTTP Last-Modified header is retained as response metadata and is not recast as a physical construction-observation timestamp.
metadata.status_scope: Paris-specific main-page text says Colt has begun construction of Paris 2, calls it the first of three new data centres being developed at the site, and says it will deliver capacity once fully operational. That combined basis supports one generic facility-build under_construction observation only, not a more specific shell, MEP, commissioning, completion, or operating stage.
metadata.related_card_guardrail: The page's sole literal 'currently under construction' occurrence belongs to a separate London 4 recommendation card. It does not describe Paris 2 and is excluded from the Paris 2 lifecycle basis.
metadata.campus_scope_guardrail: The page calls Paris 2 the first of three new data centres being developed at the 12.5-acre Villebon-sur-Yvette site. Only Paris 2, whose construction the page says has begun, is modeled as a current facility project; the two additional planned data centres do not become current projects.
metadata.capacity_precision_guardrail: The location page rounds Paris 2 to 40 MW of IT power once fully operational. The captured CY2025 report gives the more precise planned full-development figure of 39.6 MW, which controls the single structured row; 40 MW is not separate or additive capacity.
metadata.contracted_power_guardrail: The 120 MW statement covers secured contracted power for Paris 2 plus two additional planned Villebon-sur-Yvette data centres. It is not Paris 2 critical-IT capacity, current load, gross facility power, or a second Paris 2 capacity row and is not imported.
metadata.tenant_guardrail: The page says Paris 2 is fully let but names no tenant and does not establish current occupancy, current IT load, operation, or a customer role. No tenant, user, customer, or load observation is imported.
metadata.cooling_as_reported: hybrid traditional air cooling and liquid-to-chip technology
metadata.cooling_conflict_guardrail: The location page describes hybrid air and liquid-to-chip cooling, while the captured CY2025 report says cooling is delivered through a 100% air-based system. The conflict is preserved as excluded metadata; neither claim is normalized into structured data.
metadata.renewable_guardrail: Statements that the completed data centre will operate on renewable power and generate zero water waste are future operating intent, not current supply, generation, annual energy consumption, water performance, completion, or operation, and are not imported.
metadata.classification_guardrail: AI, cloud, high-density, and customer-platform wording describes intended design and future customer-use context. It is not imported as a current workload, tenant, role, or operating-model observation.
metadata.corporate_address_guardrail: The embedded JSON-LD author address Colt House, 20 Great Eastern Street, London EC2A 3EH is Colt's corporate address, not Paris 2. It is rejected; only the source-explicit Villebon-sur-Yvette locality is preserved.
metadata.coordinate_guardrail: Coordinates and geometry remain null. Villebon-sur-Yvette is an authoritative locality, not a geocode, street address, parcel, footprint, building centroid, or unique-site coordinate.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Satellite imagery and computer vision play no role in identity or lifecycle status.

evidence.title: Sustainability Report CY2025
evidence.excerpt: The official CY2025 report says Paris 2 is planned to deliver 39.6 MW of IT capacity when fully developed and separately states a design target of annualised PUE 1.27.

metadata.capacity_scope: The report says that when fully developed Paris 2 is planned to deliver 39.6 MW of IT capacity. It is imported once as planned full-facility critical-IT capacity, not current load, gross facility power, contracted power for the three-site program, grid draw, generation, or measured energy consumption.
metadata.precision_guardrail: The exact 39.6 MW report figure is more precise than the location page's rounded 40 MW display and controls the single structured capacity row. The figures are not additive and do not imply a range.
metadata.pue_guardrail: Although the report expressly types 1.27 as an annualised design target, the current capacity schema cannot preserve that full target-versus-actual and annualisation typing without ambiguity. The value remains excluded metadata and is not imported as a structured PUE row.
metadata.cooling_conflict_guardrail: The report's 100% air-based statement conflicts with the captured location page's hybrid air and liquid-to-chip description. The conflict is preserved as excluded metadata; neither cooling claim is normalized into structured data.
metadata.rooftop_solar_guardrail: The report says 1,096 square metres of rooftop solar has been installed and is intended to contribute auxiliary power. Installed area does not establish rated power, measured generation, annual energy, current facility load, grid draw, renewable share, or operation.
metadata.operation_guardrail: Future renewable-electricity, cooling, water, and workload wording describes design or intended operation. It does not establish current operation, energy supply, current load, annual energy consumption, water performance, tenant activity, completion, or commissioning.
metadata.workload_guardrail: Cloud, enterprise, machine-learning, and higher-density wording describes designed support when fully developed, not current workloads, tenants, roles, or an operating model, and is not imported.
metadata.campus_scope_guardrail: The wider Villebon-sur-Yvette site may accommodate multiple data centres over time. The report's Paris 2 case study supports only the modeled Paris 2 facility project and does not create Paris 3, Paris 4, or a program-level capacity row.
metadata.coordinate_guardrail: Coordinates and geometry remain null. Villebon-sur-Yvette is an authoritative locality, not a geocode, street address, parcel, footprint, building centroid, or unique-site coordinate.

This is not current load, 120 MW three-facility contracted power, gross facility power, grid draw, generation, measured energy consumption, or proof of completion or operation.
